_comment: gdd-faction-framework.md §10.3 Seam-A narration for FactionActionNarrator (clone of ruler_action_templates.json). Per-action phrase bank; {faction} and {leader} are substituted. The deterministic template is the final text whenever no live provider is configured or a live request fails / returns a generic fallback.

action_phrases.recruit_members: {faction} opens its rolls to new blood.
action_phrases.raise_funds: {faction} turns its hand to filling its coffers.
action_phrases.proselytize: {faction} sends its preachers into the streets.
action_phrases.court_patron: {faction} seeks the ear of those who rule.
action_phrases.post_job: {faction} lets it be known that it has work for the willing.
action_phrases.aid_faction: {faction} extends a hand to an ally.
action_phrases.hold: {faction} bides its time and guards its purse.
action_phrases.issue_decree: {leader} decrees a new apportionment of the tithe.

goal_motivation.grow_membership: Numbers are strength, and it means to have them.
goal_motivation.accumulate_wealth: Gold buys everything else, in the end.
goal_motivation.gain_influence: Power flows to those the powerful must heed.
goal_motivation.suppress_rival: A rival unchecked is a rival triumphant.
goal_motivation.defend_patron: Its fortunes are bound to its patron's.
goal_motivation.spread_doctrine: The faith must be carried to every hearth.
goal_motivation.survive: First, endure; ambition can wait for safer days.
